set.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with a verifier test that finds the six section headings in order, the shared done, test-scope, command-budget and never-list blocks expanded, the detached checkout, Never edit code, fakes only, the re-run of the Checks: block and acceptance commands with a missing block or a different exit code a finding naming the command (the verifier-reruns-reported-checks points, moved from build.md's tests), the scope and no-stub points, the Evidence apply example and the rhiza run findings heredoc, the rule that each finding names a file, command or acceptance point, and the rhiza run note line before session done; negative cases assert it carries no builder commit or trailer instructions and no edit-code instruction beyond Never edit code, and that rhiza run note appears in no check or critic topic.
set.statement: `rhiza guide verifier` gives a leaf's verifier afk's verifier prompt in Rhiza's words on the same six sections: in a detached checkout at the leaf's commit it re-runs every command of the Checks: block and every acceptance command, reads the diff and confirms each acceptance point is met and tested, nothing outside the leaf changed and no stubs or TODOs were left; it never edits code and uses fakes only; it ends with Evidence written as itself or with findings, each naming the file, command or acceptance point and what to change so a fixer can act without re-diagnosing; before session done it journals one rhiza run note line of a learning a later leaf can use when it has one; then session done as its own command.
